Company Policies
Company Leave Policy
Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days annually. Leave requests must be submitted through the HR
portal and approved by the employee's manager.

Remote Work Policy
Employees may request remote work with manager approval. Teams must maintain normal communication and
availability during working hours.

Security Policy
Employees must enable multi-factor authentication. Production credentials must be stored securely and must never
be committed to Git.
